d: Honest cop Bajrang battles mobster Firangi Paisewala—can he end the reign of terror after killing goon Kartoos?
Framed by a ruthless don, an honest cop battles betrayal and corruption to reclaim his honour and name

Yaadein is a 2001 Hindi romantic drama film starring Hrithik Roshan, Kareena Kapoor and Jackie Shroff. The story revolves around Raj Singh Puri, father of three daughters, and who works for the Malhotras.
